The '''Bolad system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Tharin sector/Legends|Tharin sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="eao" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bolad]].
